workflow.name: Generate an image (OpenAI)
workflow.description: Renders an image with OpenAI gpt-image-1 and saves it to Artifacts.

nodes.label: Render with OpenAI
nodes.prompt:
Generate an image with the OpenAI Images API and save it.

1. POST https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations with `Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY`, JSON {"model":"gpt-image-1","prompt": <prompt>, "size":"1536x1024"}. Use curl; never print the key.
2. Decode data[0].b64_json into "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/image.png".
3. Reply with the saved path.

If OPENAI_API_KEY is not set, stop and say: add OPENAI_API_KEY in Hive › Keys.

Prompt:
{{inputs.prompt}}
